title:
POV: I GAVE FLOWERS TO A
STREET CLEANER IN JERUSALEM 🇮🇱
beats: THE GIVING, one unbroken POV take: he walks up the market aisle, 'Happy holiday - for you, my dear brother', his face goes from puzzled (9-10.5s) to a full smile (12s) on 'we want to make you happy'; the girls hand him more roses, 'thank you very much', and the hold ends on his grin with the bouquet (20-21s)

WHO HE IS -> THE PAYOFF: name (Shweiki), from Abu Tor, 'do you speak English? - no' (a small laugh), 'are you Muslim? - yes' / 'I'm Jewish' and the HANDSHAKE on screen (33-34.5s), 'yalla bye'. Cut at 37.9 before the camera swings off him. 20.3-21.9 dropped: he looks down at the roses, nothing said
ENDING a: observer iPhone, later on the lit street - he stops the cart, turns to camera and smiles holding the red roses. Wordless hold. Proxy only (360p)
ENDING b: after a jump in the source clip itself (7.5s), he steps forward grinning with the roses - 'thank you'. The face with the flowers is the last image
